title: Standard repair FORWARD SHADOW test: current v9 vs repaired v9 vs market-anchored residuals vs market
approved: owner approval 2026-10-28 (Standard forensic repair brief); registration written before any forward row exists
kind: FORWARD_SHADOW - research only. No change to v9 selection, tips, stakes, thresholds, models or Telegram. v9 is checked out read-only.
observation_rule: A row counts only if scored_at > registered_at and it was written by a scoring run that used a model version from registry/standard_repair/forward_shadow_models.json. Observations therefore start at the first scoring run after the first TRAIN. Rows are never pooled with PRE_REPAIR_FORWARD evidence (output/standard_repair/pre_repair/*, forward_first_sight.csv) nor with v9r_first_sight.csv.

OU25.price_requirement: GENUINE_FORWARD_TWO_SIDED (>= 3 books quoting both sides at first sight)

BTTS.note: MKT_RESID_* not registered for BTTS: its historical anchor exists only as a SYNTHETIC_MARKET_PROXY, so training and serving anchors would differ in kind.

OU15.note: as BTTS. No row is ever written on a synthetic price; SYNTHETIC_MARKET_PROXY rows (none in v1) would be excluded from every certified ROI / CLV claim.

arms.CURRENT_V9_SERVED: the probability v9 production serves for the fixture in its committed output/predictions.csv (p_over25 / p_btts / p_over15) at the moment of first sight; v9's own model_version column is recorded
arms.V9_REPAIRED: v9 recipe v9_repaired (persisted train-only imputer, one canonical train/serve feature builder src/features_repaired.py, league-scoped, four-block stacking, date-derived weights, identity-canonical history), price_mode none, Standard-track payload per target, trained on rows strictly before the training cutoff
arms.MKT_RESID_LR: logit p = a + b*logit(p_market) + ridge(lam 0.02) on standardised GROUPS features + league intercepts (Phase-2 benchmark arm, src/studies/standard_repair/shadow_models.py)
arms.MKT_RESID_HGB: HistGradientBoosting(150, lr 0.03, depth 3, min leaf 300, l2 5) on GROUPS + league dummies + logit(p_market); Platt blend [logit m, raw - logit m] on the last 20% of training rows by date (Phase-2 benchmark arm)
arms.MARKET: de-vigged genuine two-sided forward consensus at first sight: per book LOCF of the last quote <= scoring time, power de-vig per book, median across books (ODDSAPI book_odds_snapshots + API-Football book_quotes, v9 committed files)

unit: league x market x side. Side = the direction an arm leans relative to MARKET at first sight (p_arm > p_market -> OVER/YES, else UNDER/NO). No threshold is applied anywhere.

first_sight.definition: first scoring run after registration at which every registered arm of the market is scorable for the fixture at the same instant: board generated < 24 h before, kickoff strictly in the future, rolling form present (invariant 8), genuine two-sided price
first_sight.immutability: plain append to output/standard_repair/forward_shadow.csv; an existing row_id (fixture_key|market) is never written again; later and incomplete observations go to output/standard_repair/forward_shadow_sightings/<date>.csv
first_sight.identical_rows: all arms of a market are compared on exactly the same first-sight rows
first_sight.pre_match_only: no row is written at or after kickoff

metrics.primary: mean paired log-loss difference (arm minus baseline) on identical settled first-sight rows, vs MARKET and vs CURRENT_V9_SERVED
secondary: CLV in probability points vs the CERTIFIED_T30 close only (>= 3 two-sided books, capture observed within 30 min of kickoff)
flat 1u ROI on the arm's lean side at the FIRST-LOGGED median entry price (genuine prices only)
metrics.inference: matchday block bootstrap (ISO-week blocks, 2000 resamples, seed 20261026); always N, matchdays and 95% CI

CONFIRMATORY.text: repaired v9 has lower OU25 log loss than the v9 probability production serves
MKT_RESID_HGB has lower OU25 log loss than the genuine de-vigged market
MKT_RESID_LR has lower OU25 log loss than the genuine de-vigged market
repaired v9 has lower OU25 log loss than the genuine de-vigged market

hypotheses.DISCOVERY: every league x market x side cell of every arm vs MARKET, BH-FDR within (market, arm). DISCOVERY never promotes anything; a candidate cell needs a NEW registration (new id) and its own confirmation rows.
hypotheses.benchmark_expectation_not_a_prior_result: Phase-2 CI benchmark (Pro 01c10512): OU25 dLL vs market legacy 0.0184, V9_REPAIRED 0.0111, MKT_RESID_HGB 0.0007 (2026 confirmation 0.0003, CI incl. 0); no cell passed BH. H2/H3 are therefore expected to be hard to confirm.

primary.multiplicity: Holm across the confirmatory hypotheses ready at the decision
primary.rule: CONFIRMED iff dLL < 0, 95% CI upper bound < 0 and Holm-adjusted one-sided p <= 0.05; evaluated ONCE at the first daily report where min_n and min_matchdays are met, then frozen (later reports keep monitoring but never change the decision)

secondary.note: BTTS / OU15 reported, never decide or promote

decision_rules.no_promotion: Nothing in this experiment changes production. A CONFIRMED hypothesis is evidence for an owner decision through Pro -> v9's PG-1.0 process, not a promotion.

frozen_inputs.v9_code_policy: TRAIN uses v9 main HEAD and records its SHA; SCORE checks out exactly that SHA for feature building and verifies the source digests and recipe versions match the model version (train/serve code identity). A recipe-version change in v9 makes TRAIN fail: a changed recipe is a new experiment id.

feature_manifest.V9_REPAIRED: src.features_repaired.feature_cols_for('none', STANDARD_SERVING_FEATURES) - the exact list per target is written into every model version

MKT_RESID.pro_side: form_pois_OU25 / form_gap (benchmark._features) and env_rate = league OU2.5 rate over the last 80 played matches dated strictly before the fixture

imputer.V9_REPAIRED: persisted train-only imputer inside each payload (v9 src/imputer.py)
imputer.MKT_RESID_LR: train medians + means + sds persisted in the payload

market_source.forward: v9 output/book_odds_snapshots.csv (+archive) and output/book_quotes/<date>.csv, LOCF per book and side, power de-vig, median, >= 3 two-sided books
market_source.training_anchor: football-data PRE-MATCH OU2.5 (Avg/B365/Pinnacle/BFE, class FD_PREMATCH_APPROX; closing columns never read), median power de-vig
market_source.declared_skew: training anchor and forward anchor come from different book sets and capture times

frozen_inputs.results_source: football-data via v9's own loader (src.standard_repair.load_history), joined on the canonical history club names recorded at first sight, date +-3 days, ambiguous -> unsettled; unsettled 14 days after kickoff -> VOID_NO_RESULT
frozen_inputs.close_certification: CERTIFIED_T30 = >= 3 two-sided books at kickoff (LOCF) and a capture observation of that fixture+market within 30 minutes before kickoff; everything else is UNCERTIFIED and excluded from CLV

model_versions.policy: weekly TRAIN (and on dispatch) appends a NEW immutable version (payload sha256s, GitHub release holding the payloads, v9 commit, cutoff, feature lists, library versions); SCORE uses the newest version trained before the scoring time, verifies every payload sha256 and records model_version on each row; nothing is replaced silently
model_versions.storage: payloads are GitHub release assets (tag std-shadow-<version>), not git blobs: ~4 MB per weekly version would otherwise accumulate in git history forever, and Actions artifacts expire (max 90 days) before a forward test can be audited

exclusions: fixtures without a genuine two-sided price at any pre-kickoff scoring run
